The '''Tibrin revolution''' occurred in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], following the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|outbreak]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. [[Tibrin/Legends|Tibrin]] dictator [[Suribran Tu]] wished to remain allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but his people moved to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. After Tu used strong-arm tactics to quell the uprising, Confederate [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] traveled to Tibrin and [[Death/Legends|executed]] the dictator.
